_comment: Non-secret tunables only. Account identifiers (AgentMail inbox, API keys) live in GitHub Actions secrets, not here — this file is tracked.

llm._comment: Tried in this order; first provider with an API key set (as a GitHub secret / env var) that succeeds wins. Pre-LLM pooling/relevance/summarization keeps the one remaining call's payload small enough (~6-7k tokens) that Groq/OpenRouter's free-tier token-per-minute caps are no longer a guaranteed 429 - see rank/llm_client.py.

pools._comment: Pool-2 thresholds/caps are deterministic and source-specific.

relevance._comment: enrich_all_pool2=true chosen from a same-data A/B/C calibration run on 2026-08-06 (PLAN.md D9): with it off, most dev.to/medium items never get article_text, so doc_body_chars is inert for them and non-tech scoring runs on a ~100-char description alone. With it on, 2 more genuinely non-tech dev.to items (recipe/food-themed 'landing page' posts) were correctly caught that description-only scoring missed, at the cost of enriching every pool2 item, not just the ones missing a description. Only one day of data - re-check with `main.py pools` over a few more days.

enrich._comment: Medium 403s our fetcher every time (see PLAN.md D10) - skip_sources stops enrich.ensure_text from ever attempting it, saving ~10 futile HTTP requests and ~10 permanent error lines in stats.errors per run.
